newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Reynolds & Reynolds upped.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Reynolds & Reynolds upped.

text.p: -- Jefferies & Co Inc raised its rating on shares of Reynolds & Reynolds Inc to accumulate from hold based on it being a "predominant information technology outsourcer for automotive dealers nationwide and a key consolidator in the forms management market."
-- In a statement, Jefferies said the stock is trading at 12 times its 1998 earnings forecast of $1.67/shr versus comparable companies trading at 16 times.
-- Jefferies also noted the company has improved its operating margin to 15 pct in FY96 from a low 7.9 pct in FY91.
